newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-St Barbara Mines lifts gold output.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-St Barbara Mines lifts gold output.

text.p: St Barbara Mines Ltd said on Monday it drove gold output up and production costs down in the half-year period to December 31, 1996 versus the corresponding period a year earlier

In the latest half-year, the Western Australia miner said it produced 68,936 ounces of gold at an average cash cost of A$394 an ounce, compared with 63,830 ounces produced at an average of A$422 an ounce in the year-earlier period.

St Barbara said it had an unaudited pre-tax profit of A$5.7 million for the half-year to December 31, down from A$14.6 million for the previous corresponding period, which included a profit of A$12.1 million from the closing out of some forward gold sales contracts.
Over the next 10 months, the company said it has contracts that would enable it to sell the majority of its production at an average price of A$606 an ounce.
Gold bullion currently fetches about A$453 an ounce.
Current forward sales totaled 86,208 ounces, with deliver dates extending from February 1997 to March 1998, it said.

Ore mined by St Barbara that measured greater than one gram of gold a tonne in the latest half year totalled 1,363,675 ounces, compared with 1,281,548 tonnes for the corresponding period a year ago, the company said.
Combined waste and ore that was mined in the half-year was 13,896,280 tonnes versus 16,974,677 tonnes a year earlier, reflecting a move to lower strip ratios, it said.
